# camundacluster_client_role_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a role to a client (an OAuth/OIDC client provisioned externally via the identity provider). The client inherits the authorizations associated with the role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Assign a role to an OIDC client provisioned externally through the identity
# provider. The client inherits the authorizations associated with the role.
resource "camundacluster_client_role_assignment" "example" {
  role_id   = "my-role"
  client_id = "my-oidc-client-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) The ID of the client (as issued by the identity provider) the role is assigned to.
- `role_id` (String) The ID of the role assigned to the client.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID of this assignment, composed of `role_id` and `client_id`.
